input.protocol_text: MCF10A cells were grown to confluence in 24-well plates and treated with mitomycin C (10 ug/ml) for 2 h to block proliferation. A scratch wound was made in each monolayer with a 200 ul pipette tip and the wells were washed twice with medium. Phase-contrast images were taken every hour for 19 h on an inverted microscope with a 10x objective; the pixel size of the analysed images was 0.908 um.
